answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and posts a jade seal to the cedar registry. Each epoch, all applicants meet in one walnut hall and answer one live prompt in ten minutes; answers cluster by wording and timing, and near-identical clusters forfeit every bond in them. One stand-in fills one seat, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 stand-ins at 45 credits each: 45,000 an epoch against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent answers once, pays 45, keeps its bond.
